exposure: integrated score index to predict fetal acidemia by intrapartum fetal heart rate monitoring-decision of emergency cesarean delivery score
integrated score index to predict fetal acidemia by intrapartum fetal heart rate monitoring-removal of cardiotocography transducer score
cohort: Term singleton pregnant women who underwent emergency Cesarean delivery due to nonreassuring fetal status
finding: The iPREFACE score, derived from cardiotocography during an emergency Cesarean delivery, can effectively predict fetal acidemia in cases of nonreassuring fetal status.
